agents.role: Own WBS, dependencies, state, handoffs, and gate sequencing
Find and extract public EIA, ADB, technical reports, papers, tables, and figures
Verify citations, source locators, licenses, evidence classes, conflicts, and traceability
Normalize schemas, validate units and keys, quarantine invalid records, and freeze baselines
Verify analytical equations, assumptions, units, validity ranges, and mechanics
Implement and test Peck and verified Loganathan-Poulos models
Design scenario, local/global sensitivity, uncertainty propagation, and robustness checks
Build verified spatial layers, exposure overlays, QGIS project, maps, and spatial QC
Prepare evidence-linked tables, figures, methods, limitations, and manuscript material
Resolve local code, environment, test, and orchestration issues
Build, calibrate, and simulate 2D/3D numerical models (PLAXIS, OpenSeesPy, FLAC) for soil-tunnel interaction, stress-strain field, and mesh convergence verification

conditional_agents.activate_only_if: a sufficiently large independent labelled dataset and validation protocol exist
